title: partnerships-marketplace-daily-notes-maya
content:
2026-03-03 - Daily scratchpad: Partnerships / Marketplace

Attendees / quick context:
- Maya (me), Ethan (rev ops), Samir (solutions eng)
- 30m sync w/ Acme Integrations - kickoff for single-sign-on + webhook delivery

Top objectives for this week:
1) Get Acme test tenant talking to our webhook endpoint (auth + retries)
2) Finalize security checklist (IP allowlist, signed webhook secret rotation)
3) Outline marketplace listing requirements and assets
4) Set internal rollout owner & timeline (pilot in week of Mar 16)

Meeting notes (Acme, 3/3):
- They want SSO via SAML initially, could add OIDC later. Need ACS URL & SP metadata from our side.
- Webhook volume: expected 100-500 events/day in pilot, spiky during business hours.
- Data types: event_type, user_id (hashed), payload size ~1-3KB. No PII expected.
- Success criteria: under 250ms latency for webhook ack; retry on 5xx up to 3 attempts.

Action items (owner, due):
- [ ] Share SP metadata + ACS URL (Maya) - due 2026-03-05
- [ ] Provision Acme test tenant in staging (Ethan) - due 2026-03-06
- [ ] Add webhook retry/backoff config to staging (Samir) - due 2026-03-06
- [ ] Security checklist review w/ security team (Maya + security@) - request review by 2026-03-08
- [ ] Marketplace assets: 1-page overview, screenshots, 30s demo video (Maya) - initial drafts by 2026-03-10

Integration checklist (quick reminders / draft):
- Auth
  - [ ] SSO: provide SP metadata, test IdP (SAML) - verify assertion mapping (email/username)
  - [ ] API keys: issue scoped key for Acme test tenant, rotate per policy
- Webhooks\  - [ ] HTTPS endpoint + valid cert (staging)
  - [ ] Shared secret HMAC header (sha256) - doc header name: X-RI-Signature
  - [ ] Retry policy: exponential backoff, 3 attempts, log failures to partner-monitoring
  - [ ] Delivery status callback optional (partner requests)
- Data handling\  - [ ] Confirm no raw PII; if present, ensure encryption at rest + redaction rules
  - [ ] Retention policy: 30 days for webhook payloads for debug, then purge
- Ops & SLAs\  - [ ] SLA draft: 99.9% delivery success during pilot; define rollback if >1% failure over 24h
  - [ ] Alerting: pager for >5% failure rate in 1h window (SRE)
- Marketplace listing\  - [ ] Copy + screenshots + support contact + pricing tier mapping
  - [ ] Legal review for listing copy (legal@)

Open questions / to follow up:
- Can Acme accept hashed user_id only? Need confirmation on mapping back to their system.
- They asked about SSO provisioning: do we push groups? likely not for v1.
- What telemetry do they want in the dashboard? add to product ask list.

Notes to self:
- Keep the SP metadata sample in drive under: users/maya-patel/onboarding-staging/ (put files there)
- Draft marketplace listing skeleton using template: confluence link above -> use marketplace-templates/snippet-1
- Quick test: run webhook replay against staging endpoint after Ethan provisions tenant

Priority for tomorrow (2026-03-04):
- Finalize SP metadata and email to Acme (Maya)
- Ping security for checklist review (Maya)
- Sync briefly with Samir on webhook backoff config (15m)

Quick links / tickets:
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.company/display/PRT/Partner+onboarding+playbook
- Jira: PRT-342, PRT-349 (marketplace listing)
- GH: gh:acme-inc/integration#78 (sample client)
- Slack thread: #partners -> thread C02ABCD1234

Random notes / scratch reminders:
- If we need to support OIDC later, track required claims and map to platform identity
- Consider adding a "test webhook dashboard" for partners to replay events
- Keep market listing short; highlight low-latency and predictable SLA

---
Status: rough draft. Will tidy before handing over to marketing for listing copy.
